_about: L01 (Login process layer): server-link layouts checked in the 2016 Login code (names from the 2016 Login PDB, pdb2016), and the WORLD struct status note corrected (L01 §2.5 / §3). Overrides the L00 / annotations.json WORLD entry.

WORLD.basis: login InitWorldManagerInfo FUN_00409eb0, GetWorldManagerConnectInfo FUN_0040a020, client WorldSelectWin::UpdateServerList FUN_00473b80; official element = PROTO_NC_USER_LOGIN_ACK.WorldInfo (pdb2016)
fields: worldstatus = WORLD_MANAGER_SERVER_USER_STATUS (pdb2016): 0 CLOSED (configured world, WM not connected), 2 EMPTY (world without a WM client-port row), 4 UNKNOWN, 5 FULL, 6..10 WMSUS_1..5 load bands (WM connected; L01 §3); the server lets world select pass for status >= 5

0x0802.name: NC_MISC_S2SCONNECTION_REQ
0x0802.basis: received from the WM: FUN_00408170; sent to AccountDB / AccountLogDB: FUN_00403a40 / FUN_00404f50 (raw frame 09 02 08 …)
fields: receiver type: 0 AccountDB, 1 AccountLog, 4 Login (WM link closed unless 4)
WM: indexes the world mapping without a bound (L01-B1)
must equal server_to_id + server_from_id (not a secret)
0x0802.notes: 7 bytes, PROTO_NC_MISC_S2SCONNECTION_REQ (pdb2016). L00 §5.1 shows only { myServerId, myWorld, myZone }

0x0803.name: NC_MISC_S2SCONNECTION_ACK
0x0803.basis: sent to the WM by FUN_00408170 (CSendPacket::ID(0x803, 3, …)); received from the DB links by FUN_00404fb0

0x0808.name: NC_MISC_USER_COUNT_CMD
fields: capacity; the load band is NumOfUser against pct(MaxOfUser) of m_LoginUserRatable[world]
0x0808.notes: world = the session's m_Connected_World; the first 0x0808 after a WM connects broadcasts 0x0C1C to every client (L01 §3)

0x2812.name: NC_OPTOOL_LOGIN_USER_RATABLE_GET_REQ
0x2812.notes: answered with 0x2813 { u8 nWorldNo, LOGIN_USER_RATABLE RateTable }; no length check (L01-B5)

0x2814.name: NC_OPTOOL_LOGIN_USER_RATABLE_SET_CMD
0x2814.notes: 13 bytes; no answer; no length or value check (L01-B5); defaults 3, 5, 8, 10, 30, 95

0x2818.name: NC_OPTOOL_LOGON_PROCESS_TIME_VIEW_REQ
0x2818.notes: answered with 0x2819 NC_OPTOOL_LOGON_PROCESS_TIME_VIEW_ACK, all six u32 counters 0 (L01-B10)
